sentences.text:
(G.R. Case ... vs In Re: Sanjoy Malik @
Sanjoy Mallik on 10 May, 2024  10.05.2024  Sl. No.17  akd  [Adjourned]
 C. R. M. (DB) 1404 of 20  In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of t  Procedure filed on 24.04.2024 in connection with
Jaga  Station Case No.77 of 2021 dated 01.04.2021 under Sec  498A/304B/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  Dowry Prohibition Act.

And  In Re: Sanjoy Malik @ Sanjoy Mallik  ... .
 Mr. Arnab Sinha  Mr. Arka Ranjan Bhattacharya  Mr. Souvik Ghosh  ... ... for the petiti  Mr. Bibaswan Bhattacharya  Ms. Atulya Sinha  ... ... for the State

1. 
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is in custody for more than two years.
It is further submitted case has not yet been committed as the de-facto complainant prayed for further investigation.
Accordingly, he renews his prayer for bail.
2. State is directed to submit report with regard to the status of the proceeding on the adjourned day.

3. Let the matter appear under the same heading on 17.05.2024.
4. Officer-in-charge, Jagacha Police Station shall notify the de-facto complainant with regard to the pendency of the proceeding and his right to participate therein.
(Ajay Kumar Gupta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By :
